data.name: Rajaa
data.gender_notes: Rajaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One who is Returned to the Right Path after Deviation. The name Rajaa carries the meaning “The One who is Returned” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rajaa usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who is returned and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and renewal for those who have strayed from their spiritual path and seek redemption
data.etymology: Rajaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One who is Returned.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajaa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رَجاء
in_arabic.meaning: الأمل والتمني والرجاء في الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: رَجاء هو اسم مشتق من الفعل رَجَا يَرْجُو رَجاءً، ويعني الأمل والتمني والرجاء في الله تعالى. ورد ذكر الرجاء في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَرَجاءٌ مِّنَ اللّهِ وَرَحْمَةٌ' (الحديد: 21). يعتبر اسم رَجاء من الأسماء الجميلة التي تعبر عن الأمل والثقة بالله.

in_urdu.name: رجا
in_urdu.long_meaning: رجا ایک نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفعل رَجَا سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے امید اور تمنا۔ اردو میں، رجا کا استعمال امید اور اللہ پر بھروسے کے معنی میں ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ نام اسلامی اقدار اور روحانیت کے ساتھ جڑا ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: राजा
in_hindi.long_meaning: राजा एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के शब्द रजा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आशा और ईश्वर पर विश्वास। हिंदी में, राजा का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, जो आशा और आध्यात्मिकता का प्रतीक है। इस नाम का चयन करने वाले माता-पिता अपने बच्चों में अच्छे गुणों को विकसित करने की कामना करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: رجا
in_pashto.meaning: هیله او پر الله باندې باور
in_pashto.long_meaning: رجا د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې د رَجَا فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، مانا یې هیله او تمنا ده. په پښتو کلتور کې، رجا د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړلی يو مشهور نوم دی، چې د الهي مرستې او رزاقیت په معنا کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Rajaa
in_english.long_meaning: Rajaa is an Arabic name derived from the root R-J-W, which means hope, expectation, and trust in God. The name Rajaa appears in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of hope and mercy from Allah (Quran 57:21). In Islamic tradition, Rajaa symbolizes a positive outlook and faith in divine providence. Parents choose this name to instill virtues of optimism and spiritual reliance in their child.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rajaa" in Islamic culture is considered a fortunate and reassuring name due to its association with the return to the right path. In many communities, a child named Rajaa is viewed as a symbol of resilience and determination as the name implies that the individual may face hardships and setbacks in life, but will ultimately prevail and find their way back to the right path.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rajaa holds immense significance in Islamic belief systems. It is a reminder of the importance of staying steadfast on the path of righteousness and seeking guidance from Allah when one strays. The name also serves as a source of comfort and hope, assuring individuals that even if they have strayed from their faith, they can always return to Allah and seek His forgiveness. Ultimately, the name Rajaa reflects the fundamental Islamic belief in Allah's mercy and compassion towards His creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The One who is Returned" symbolizes The One who is Returned to the Right Path after Deviation. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rajaa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the one who is returned.
